summary: One-line fix converts a DataArray `other` into a Dataset via `to_dataset()` before merging, directly resolving the reported AttributeError and mirroring how the top-level `xr.merge()` already handles this case.

issues.description: An unnamed DataArray passed to `ds.merge(da)` will raise a ValueError from `to_dataset()` requiring a name, but this matches the existing behavior of `xr.merge()` for the same input, so it's not a new edge case introduced by this change.
